fields.label: Client UUID
fields.description: Client-generated UUID minted by the SK app per event -- the document's naming field, and what makes batch ingest idempotent under retry (a resend with the same id is a no-op, never a duplicate row).

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: Stamped server-side from the authenticated caller's tenantId header -- never trusted from the request payload.

fields.label: Event Type
fields.description: e.g. "visit_completed", "counselling_share". Deliberately not a Select -- the report builder must tolerate and ignore an event type it doesn't recognise (a newer client talking to an older deployment), which a hard-validated Select would break.

fields.label: Visit UUID
fields.description: Random per-visit correlator minted by the client for telemetry alone -- never a patient, member or encounter id. This table is deliberately not patient-linked and stays out of PHI scope.

fields.label: SK User ID
fields.description: Client-supplied grouping key for per-SK counts. NOT an identity claim -- must never be used for access control.
